overview_description.description:
Metis facilitates boot camps, events, online training programs, part-time professional development programs, and corporate programs that focus on the career development of data scientists.

Metis offers an online platform that enables its users to find information about its events and training programs.

Metis has offices in Chicago, New York, San Francisco, and Seattle. It was founded by Jason Moss in 2013.
